## Summary

**PR #424 rescued and merged successfully** (TIER1).

- **PR:** FChecklist/compliance-tracker#424, "AI Cost Governance & FinOps: anomaly detection, spend forecast, idle capacity"
- **Tier:** TIER1 (no drizzle/schema changes)
- **Final CI state:** All required checks green (Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E Tests, audit-check, Guardrail Presence, Asset Registry Coverage). Only the non-required Vercel preview failed (build-rate-limited — documented, doesn't block merge).
- **Merged as:** squash commit `cc1af35d`

**Real work done:**
- Merged `origin/main` into the PR branch **three times** — main kept advancing mid-rescue from sibling concurrent rescue sessions (PR #422 "proactive cost-ceiling alerts" landed, then its own rescue-claim chore commit landed).
- One genuine source-code overlap: `src/lib/cost-guard.ts` was touched by both this PR and PR #422. Auto-merged cleanly (disjoint additions — PR #422 added `checkCostCeilingBreaches`/`classifyCostBreach`, this PR added `forecastedMonthEndSpendUsd`), verified by reading the merged file in full rather than trusting the auto-merge.
- Re-ran `tsc`/`lint`/`bun test` after each merge (final: 0 type errors, 0 lint errors, 1519/1519 tests pass).
- The first Mandatory Audit Check CI run failed because it fired on push before my audit comment existed — re-ran that job after posting; passed.
- Read the full 14-file diff by hand, posted a structured `AUDIT: PASS` comment with all 8 required fields.
- Closed the loop on `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` bookkeeping via a separate small PR (#447, also merged) moving the claim to `recently_completed`.

No code bugs needed fixing in the PR's own logic — the original CI failures were entirely due to the missing audit verdict and staleness against main, both resolved by the rebase + audit comment.
